title: Staggered credit rollforward and enterprise security‑QA alignment for PLG trial conversions
creator: Oliver Patel
description: Goal: increase paid conversion rate from free/trial usage without materially increasing cost-per-conversion or enabling abuse. We will run a staggered credit rollforward experiment (allowing unused trial credits to roll forward into a downgraded trial state or short-term top-up) combined with targeted upgrade prompts for teams that hit specific security questionnaire or contract thresholds. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Legal, Sales Engineering, and Security to define policies, data instrumentation, messaging, and gating for enterprise security QA during trial→contract conversations.
hypothesis: Providing a cautious rollforward policy and tailored upgrade prompts that surface enterprise security questionnaire options will increase trial→paid conversion by 12% while keeping cost-per-conversion increase under 20% and reducing churn from enterprise prospects due to security friction.
experiment_variants: Variant A - Conservative: 60-day expiry, no rollforward, single upgrade banner at 80% credit usage
Variant B - Rollforward: 90-day expiry + single-rollforward of up to 25% unused credits when user requests upgrade prompt; upgrade prompt appears at 70% usage with enterprise questionnaire CTA
Variant C - Generous: 180-day expiry + automatic 10% rollforward for accounts with verified org email; multi-touch upgrade prompts at 40% and 85% usage including security questionnaire flow
Control: Current baseline free trial configuration (existing credit size and 30-day expiry)
credit_size_and_allocation: Primary cohorts will use three credit sizes: 50k tokens (light), 150k tokens (standard), 300k tokens (heavy).
Segmentation by signup source: self-serve web signups default to 150k, partner referrals default to 300k, developer playground signups default to 50k.
acceptance_criteria: Safe backend rollout path implemented and tested in staging (feature flag gated)
Instrumentation: events emitted for credit_issued, credit_consumed, credit_rollforward_applied, upgrade_prompt_shown, questionnaire_started, questionnaire_completed, trial_converted_to_paid
Dashboard in console showing conversion lift by variant and cohort within 7 days of experiment start
Legal and Security sign-off on the enterprise questionnaire gating copy and data retention expectations
Abuse detection thresholds configured and tested to prevent credit farming (rate limits + heuristics)
metrics_to_track: Primary: trial->paid conversion rate by variant
Secondary: cost-per-conversion (compute tokens consumed * infrastructure cost model)
Signal: median time-to-first-bill, fraction of accounts requesting rollforward, questionnaire completion rate
Safety: accounts flagged by abuse heuristics, percent of credits unused per cohort
measurement_plan: Pre-experiment baseline window: capture last 60 days of trial behavior for baseline conversion and cost metrics
Randomized assignment at account level with stratification by signup source and org size
Minimum detectable effect: 8% relative uplift in conversion at 80% power → target sample size calculation included in confluence doc
Analysis notebook and SQL in BigQuery with pre-registered queries (link below)
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Feature-flagged release to 5% of new signups internal to variant cohorts for 2 weeks
Stage 2: Ramp to 25% for 1 week if no safety triggers
Stage 3: Full rollout for the experiment window (6–8 weeks) if thresholds pass
Rollback criteria: >2x baseline abuse rate or >20% increase in cost-per-conversion vs. control
technical_notes: Backend: add credit_rollforward flag and two new fields on entitlement record (rollforward_allowed_until, rollforward_amount_remaining) - feature-flagged
Billing: ensure rollforwarded credits are accounted against promo bucket and do not incorrectly reduce meterable usage in the first paid invoice
Console UX: new modal for upgrade prompts with 'Start security questionnaire' CTA and link to Sales Engineering flow
Telemetry: use existing telemetry namespace trial.* and add trial.rollforward.* events
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Credit farming by creating many throwaway accounts. Mitigation: require email domain verification for rollforward eligibility and enforce IP/device heuristics.
Risk: Legal/regulatory concerns around extending trial value. Mitigation: Legal sign-off and explicit TOS notice during rollforward acceptance.
Risk: Unexpected cost uplift. Mitigation: conservative initial cohort size + cost monitoring with automatic ramp-down on threshold breach.
